title: Why Does The Cookie Keep Escaping?
description: Original 40-second visual animal mystery-comedy built around repeated expectation resets, a fair visual clue, reveal payoff, and seamless loop.
hook: A red panda reaches for a cookie in the first frame, but the cookie suddenly shoots away by itself.
retention_beats: 3-7s second grab fails as reflection seems wrong
7-12s cookie slips behind a cup and crumbs point toward mirror
12-17s red panda traps the cookie but it moves again
17-23s mirror reflection appears to lag, creating a false supernatural explanation
23-29s thin thread briefly catches light and the chase accelerates
29-36s reveal: a tiny mouse behind the mirror has been pulling the cookie and shares it
36-40s a second cookie snaps toward lens to restart the chase
rewatch_trigger: A tiny mouse ear is visible for a fraction of a second at the mirror edge early in the story, fairly foreshadowing the reveal.
loop_bridge: The second cookie fills the final frame moving in the same direction and speed as the escaping cookie in frame one, with the same crisp slide sound.

scenes.background: cozy breakfast nook with floor mirror
scenes.caption: HEY!
scenes.camera: macro cookie close-up into fast pullback
scenes.action: Red panda paw almost touches a cookie; it suddenly shoots sideways before contact.

scenes.caption: AGAIN?
scenes.camera: low tracking shot with quick reaction cut
scenes.action: Red panda lunges again; cookie changes direction while its mirror reflection seems one beat late.

scenes.caption: A CLUE?
scenes.camera: follow crumbs into slow push toward mirror
scenes.action: Cookie slips behind a cup; a fresh crumb trail points toward the mirror. A tiny ear briefly peeks from its edge.

scenes.caption: GOT YOU.
scenes.action: Red panda traps the cookie under both paws and smiles; the cookie slowly slides out anyway.

scenes.caption: WHAT?!
scenes.camera: tight push on mirror then rack focus
scenes.action: The mirror image appears to move late, making the red panda stare at its own reflection while the cookie escapes behind it.

scenes.caption: WAIT…
scenes.camera: fast lateral chase with brief slow-motion glint
scenes.action: A nearly invisible thread catches sunlight for an instant as the cookie races toward the mirror.

scenes.background: behind the floor mirror in same nook
scenes.caption: OH.
scenes.camera: whip around mirror into warm close-up
scenes.action: A tiny mouse is revealed holding the thread. It breaks the cookie in two and offers half; red panda softens and accepts.
Mouse tugs a second cookie; it rockets past the smiling red panda straight into the camera until it fills the frame.
